detail: Rights Issue — Sumeet Industries Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on July 22, 2026, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 8 : 25, i.e 8 Equity Shares for every 25 Equity Shares held. Issue Price is Rs. 11.86 per share.
